name: Security Classification Type 2 Choice
definition: Choice between a CFI code and an other type of identification for the classification of a financial instrument.

CFI.name: CFI
CFI.definition: Classification type of the financial instrument, as per the ISO 10962 Classification of Financial Instrument (CFI) codification.

AlternateClassification.name: Alternate Classification
AlternateClassification.definition: Other type of classification of the financial instrument.
